g.text: Dynamic Security Scanner, Fuzzing Engine & Container Observer for MCP

svg.text: Limits: 256MB RAM | 0.5 CPU | Network Disabled | auto_remove
Clean schema validation, rejects bad inputs cleanly via JSON-RPC
Weak error handling: unhandled KeyError & split(":") IndexError
Leans into unhandled server crashes & raw stack trace leaks
Discloses fake DB_CONNECTION_STRING & file paths via verbose=True
- Spikes flagged if Peak RAM > 200MB (80% of limit)
- Detects frozen / hanging containers vs timeout
- Non-zero exit code → Segfault / unhandled crash
- Captures stderr logs (tail=10) on abnormal exit
Rule order evaluates highest severity first.
